title: Value and Satisfaction Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 4
description:
Six laddoos cost 120 rupees, a packet of biscuits costs 30, yet Mrs. Rao picks the laddoos every single week. Why? In this animated lesson, Laddoo Lab, a tiny millet laddoo brand from a home kitchen in Bengaluru, shows the two ideas that explain it: customer value and customer satisfaction.

You will see Philip Kotler and Kevin Lane Keller's definition of customer perceived value, all the benefits minus all the costs compared with other choices, and why perceived means it lives in the customer's eyes. We build Mrs. Rao's value check block by block, then watch satisfaction happen live: three weeks of morning deliveries against a promise of 7:00, one late, one on time and one with a handwritten note from Nani, giving dissatisfied, satisfied and delighted. We spot benefits, costs, expectations and delight at work today in a bank, a food delivery app, an airline and a hotel, and look honestly at the human side: big promises raise expectations, extras cost money, and Noriaki Kano's 1984 model shows that today's delight slowly becomes tomorrow's basic need.

This is Episode 4 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
